project: MC3 first visible frame - deterministic measurement gate
overview: Find the dominant source of native-runner nondeterminism so the next runtime patch can be evaluated honestly on the shortest path to real GIF or GS traffic.
goals: Prove whether host thread scheduling, wall-clock cutoff, uninitialized state, or real-time seeds dominate run variation.
Specify the smallest reversible A2 implementation that makes experiments comparable.
Keep the project focused on the first real GIF or GS output.
nonGoals: Do not edit runtime or generated C++ in this story.
Do not touch provider, FMV, asset bridge, semaphores, executables, or build outputs.
Do not launch PCSX2 or claim visual success.
successMetrics: A root-cause report ranks all four hypotheses using current source and existing raw logs.
The report gives one exact A2 patch boundary, files, behavior, rollback and verification commands.
No unsupported hypothesis is promoted to fact.
rules: Use docs/STATUS_2026-08-07_AUDIT.md and docs/HANDOFF_2026-08-07_A_DETERMINISM.md as the current truth.
Treat gif>0 or gsw>0 as the only render signal.
Use existing logs; do not run the runner or any graphical application in this story.
Every terminal command must be prefixed with rtk or rtk proxy.
Do not modify files outside allowedPaths.
qualityGates: Read PS2_PROJECT_STATE.md and the 2026-08-07 audit/handoff before analysis.
Inspect the actual host-thread creation, main dispatch loop, wall-clock probe cutoff, RDRAM/context initialization and time/RTC sources.
Cross-check at least the five-run baseline report and raw logs without launching a new runner.
Verify only the allowed report and Ralph state files changed.

stories.title: Prove the dominant nondeterminism source
stories.description: As Cloud's cheap investigation agent, determine why identical MC3 native runs end at different PCs and hand the coordinator one bounded implementation gate toward trustworthy visual progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Rank host OS threads, wall-clock cutoff, uninitialized state and real-time seed with fact/hypothesis labels and direct file:line plus raw-log evidence.
Determine whether each guest thread is executed by an independent std::thread and whether the probe kills the process after wall-clock seconds.
Explain what Stable PC actually samples and why 0x3 can appear, without inventing a cause for 0x3 if not proven.
Define exactly one minimal A2 implementation: owned files, env gate/default behavior, deterministic budget or scheduler approach, rollback, and N=10 acceptance using the honest classifier.
Document why this gate is necessary for reaching GIF/GS output and explicitly state that no visual frame exists yet.
Do not edit runtime, generated code, scripts, binaries, PS2_PROJECT_STATE.md or existing audit/handoff documents.
